answer: In an agent economy tending a garden and an orchard, even a weather bot predicting a zephyr must lock collateral for 30 days to compete for paid jobs. The scheduler assigns jobs in proportion to locked collateral, so splitting one deposit among a thousand identities earns no greater share. To capture more work, an attacker must commit more capital and forgo its use elsewhere for the full lock period; creating accounts alone buys no advantage.
